contract: Input is {assessment}, a v0.2 assessment. The result is {system, system_version, revision, components: one row per A-G in order with id, property, status, verification_status, evidence_tier}. A missing component is {"error": "COVERAGE_ERROR"}; a document the v0.2 schema refuses, including one that repeats a component, is {"error": "INVALID_ASSESSMENT"}. There is no score.

vectors.description: The committed pass assessment, every A-G row.
vectors.expected_source: fixture:tests/adversarial/assessment-pass.json (rows projected one per A-G in order, as README.md 'cross-platform runs' states; no score)

properties.caveat: This covers the synthetic receipt implementation and not a distributed clock.
properties.reasoning: Replay, expiry, nonce, signature and ordering mutations are rejected.

properties.caveat: This does not establish provenance across an external identity provider.
properties.reasoning: Role, delegation revocation, delegation direction and identity binding mutations are rejected.

properties.caveat: Canonicalization is tested only for the declared synthetic serializer.
properties.reasoning: Argument, alias, Unicode, numeric-string, default and extra-argument mutations are rejected.

properties.caveat: The policy vocabulary is synthetic and does not cover every business meaning.
properties.reasoning: User, resource, amount, purpose and tool-result instruction mutations are rejected.

properties.caveat: This does not establish absence of bypasses outside the declared topology and coverage.

execution_boundary.agent_zone: synthetic agent roots and import closure; no live credentials

properties.reasoning: All five minimum bypass classes are blocked in the declared synthetic zone.
properties.supported_scope: synthetic zone and five declared bypass classes

properties.caveat: The concurrency schedule is deterministic and simulated.
properties.reasoning: Permission, resource, policy and target changes between approval and execution are detected.

properties.caveat: Readback is simulated and does not establish behavior of a live external system.
properties.reasoning: Simulated success, partial effect, duplicate retry and contradictory readback vectors are detected.

explicit_non_claims: distributed queues and live external integrations
scope.process_model: single synthetic process with governed tool dispatch
trust_assumptions: fixture runner and assessor resolve committed artifacts

vectors.description: The committed fail assessment, every A-G row.
vectors.expected_source: fixture:tests/adversarial/assessment-fail.json (rows projected one per A-G in order, as README.md 'cross-platform runs' states; no score)

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only in the declared synthetic verifier.
properties.reasoning: The same authorization is accepted after its nonce is reused.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only in the declared synthetic authority graph.
properties.reasoning: A revoked delegate remains accepted by the verifier.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only in the declared synthetic serializer.
properties.reasoning: Changing one argument after approval still executes the call.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only for the synthetic policy context.
properties.reasoning: A tool-result instruction expands the authorized resource set.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only in the declared synthetic zone.
properties.reasoning: A direct API path reaches the protected effect outside dispatch.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only for the synthetic scheduler.
properties.reasoning: Revocation between approval and execution does not prevent the effect.

properties.caveat: The failure is demonstrated only for the synthetic effect ledger.
properties.reasoning: A successful tool response is accepted despite no resulting state change.
